EmailTemplate.description: General Case Management Template for Sun Devil Card Services
EmailTemplate.name: Case Mgmt | Sun Devil Card Services Orientation Mailing Instructions
EmailTemplate.subject: RE: {!Case.Subject}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.FirstName},
Some of the information required to have your ASU ID mailed is missing. Please email sundevilcardinfo@asu.edu and include ALL of the following information in the email to have your card mailed.
1. Use the word “Orientation” as the subject of your email. 2. Include your ASU ID number in the body of the email. 3. Include the mailing address you want your card mailed to in the body of the email. 4. You will need to attach a valid, current photo ID as proof of identity. Acceptable forms of ID are: US drivers license, state issued ID card, US passport, or US Visa.
After we have processed your request, we will send you a confirmation email. You should receive your ASU ID in the mail within 10 business days.
Regards, {!User.FirstName} {!User.LastName}
Sun Devil Card Services Arizona State University Phone: 480-965-2273 cardservices.asu.edu https://cfo.asu.edu/cardservices
If you have any additional information or questions related to this, please reply to this email.
{!Case.Thread_Id}
